entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
This is ridiculous! Connect me to a person now!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Your company sold me garbage! These cycling shoes are a total rip-off. I wore them on one ride and they gave me massive blisters. I want my money back immediately!
I'm very sorry to hear about your experience, sir. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Tom Harris, order VF-78901. And don't give me the runaround. I tried adjusting the cleats, I tried different socks, nothing works. These things are torture devices. If I don't get a full refund, I'm plastering one-star reviews on every website I can find. Get me your manager!

Sir, I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak with a manager. I can absolutely process this return for you. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see you purchased the Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered five days ago.
Yeah, five days of my feet being in agony. So are you going to give me my money back or not?

Yes, of course. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return policy. I am processing your full refund authorization right now. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to you. Please place the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any postal service location.
Oh. So... I just mail them back and I get my refund? That's it?
That's correct. Once our warehouse scans the return, the refund will be credited back to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days.
Alright. Okay, that's fine then. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mr. Harris. I'm sorry again that the shoes didn't work out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
